$description: Generated from DESIGN.md by `cargo xtask design`. Do not edit. Colors are the default appearance.

text.$description: Body text; step 12 is Radix's high-contrast text.

text-secondary.$description: Labels, captions and the field note; step 11 is Radix's low-contrast text, still AA on steps 1-3.

accent-text.$description: Accented text on a plain surface, such as a link in widget content.

accent-strong.$description: Text on a soft accent; step 11 on step 3 of the same scale is under 4.5:1 for some scales.

border-control.$description: A control's boundary identifies it and needs 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11); Radix's border steps 6-8 fall short.

divider.$description: Radix's subtle border step, for lines between rows and around the chrome.

ok-icon.$description: The status icon carries the status beside gray text, so it needs 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11).

warning-icon.$description: As ok-icon; amber 9 is too light to carry meaning on a light surface.

focus.$description: The host's own focus ring; Radix's focus-ring steps 7-8 fail 3:1, and a widget-colored ring would vanish on lime or sky.

canvas.$description: The window behind the frames; Radix's app background steps.

surface.$description: A widget's frame and the fields drawn in it, one step off the canvas so frames stand out.

neutral-soft.$description: Buttons, the monogram and badges: Radix's component background step.

accent-soft.$description: An accented button or badge: the widget color's component background step.

ok-soft.$description: The background of an ok badge.

warning-soft.$description: The background of a warning badge.

error-soft.$description: The background of an error badge.

chrome-surface.$description: The host's own bar, in the host color when there is one; no frame or panel covers it.

dialog-surface.$description: A host dialog's surface; what tells a dialog apart is its form, not this color.

panel-surface.$description: The panel a frame opens for a plugin's controls, attached to that frame.

scrim.$description: Dims the window behind a host dialog; blackA because gray 12 is near white in the dark theme.

label-sm.$description: Frame labels, badges and the monogram: small but medium weight so it holds.

body-md.$description: Body text and fields: 14 px reads well at desktop distance and fits dense widgets.

label-md.$description: Buttons and the chrome: body size, medium weight.

display.$description: The largest figure a widget shows, such as a timer.

xxs.$description: Between an icon and its label.

sm.$description: Between related items, and a field's padding.

md.$description: A frame's padding and the grid's gutter.

small.$description: The monogram, and corners when the person picks small.

medium.$description: The default: frames, buttons and fields.

large.$description: Dialogs, a step rounder than what they float over.

full.$description: Pills: badges, and every corner when the person picks full.

frame.$description: A hint of lift so a frame reads as one object on the canvas.

panel.$description: A panel floats beside its frame, never over the chrome.

dialog.$description: A host dialog floats above everything, over the scrim.
